name: To Hulfdan!
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.

narrative.details:
Where have you been, adventurer? Hulfdan's been looking all over the place for you. We thought the king may have put you in irons.

Get to Ironforge as soon as possible and speak with Hulfdan!
narrative.objectives: Travel to Ironforge and speak with Hulfdan Blackbeard.
narrative.offerRewardText: Keep yer voice down, adventurer, the guards may hear ye.

chain.subtitle: 4 quests from level 16 to 20, 1,910 XP in all.

quests.name: To Hulfdan!
quests.objectiveText: Travel to Ironforge and speak with Hulfdan Blackbeard.

quests.name: Kingly Shakedown
quests.objectiveText: Travel to Stormwind and seek out Renzik "The Shiv."

quests.name: Redridge Rendezvous
quests.objectiveText: Venture forth to Lakeshire in the Redridge Mountains and speak with Lucius.

quests.name: Alther's Mill
quests.objectiveText: Open Lucius's Lockbox, recover the Token of Thievery and return it to Lucius in Lakeshire.
